name: Gemma 3n E2B IT
definition: Gemma 3n E2B IT is an open-weight AI model published by Google DeepMind. OpenWeightModels records it for mobile multimodal assistants, audio, vision and local inference.

eu_deployment.self_hosting: Technically possible on EU/EEA infrastructure when the weights, runtime and connected services are operated there.
eu_deployment.data_residency: Provider origin does not determine data residency. Review inference, RAG, embeddings, logs, telemetry, backups and subprocessors.
